traceability.notes:
All requirements of story 024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS are implemented and verified:
- REQ-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE: normalizeCommentLine uses a global /`[^`]*`/g regex to strip backtick-wrapped spans, ensuring inline-code references like `@story`, `@req`, and `@supports` are removed from consideration before annotation detection. - REQ-PRESERVE-BOUNDARIES: Each backtick span is replaced by spaces of equal length, preserving string length and word boundaries; tests assert the exact resulting strings (e.g., "`@story` + `@req` docs" -> " + docs"). - REQ-CENTRALIZED-FILTER and IMPL-NORMALIZE-COMMENT: The behavior is implemented in the shared normalizeCommentLine helper in src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-format-internal.ts, which is already the central normalization point for annotation parsing. - Acceptance criteria are covered by targeted tests: ignoring backtick-wrapped keywords (core functionality), handling common documentation patterns, correctly detecting real annotations when mixed with inline-code references, and ensuring non-backtick lines are unchanged except for existing normalization. The function operates per line, so the same logic applies regardless of which line in a multi-line comment the backtick spans appear on. - No-regression criterion is met: the full Jest suite, including the new tests for this story, passes successfully. - Documentation criterion is satisfied via the detailed JSDoc-style comment on normalizeCommentLine plus the story file itself, which together explain the inline code filtering behavior.
Based on code inspection, dedicated tests, and a full passing test run, this story is fully implemented.
